title: Signing of the handover of a new section of the strategic Rasht–Astara railway project with Russia
text:
Signing of the handover of a new section of the strategic Rasht–Astara railway project with Russia"

"🔹 At this stage of the contract, 37 km of the railway route was handed over to the company “Caspian Services Russia.”"

"🔹 Taking into account last year’s progress, when 125 km of the project was signed off, the total handed-over route has reached 162 km."

"🔹 This step-by-step process paves the way for finalizing larger commercial contracts in the near future and for diplomatic-economic trips aimed at signing final agreements.
